question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Authentic
solution:
The correct answer is: **False.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Authentic"** means something that is genuine, real, or true. (प्रामाणिक)

 
 
• **Example: **The museum has an authentic piece of the Berlin Wall on display.
 
 
 
• **"False" **refers to something that is not true, incorrect, or fake. (झूठा)
 
 
• **Example: **The document was proven to be false after thorough verification.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Authentic' **is **'False'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Moderate **(मध्यम): Average in amount, intensity, quality, or degree.

 
 
• **Example:** The weather was moderate, neither too hot nor too cold.
 
 
 
• **Actual **(वास्तविक): Existing in fact; real.
 
 
• **Example: **The actual cost of the project was much higher than the initial estimate.
 
 
 
• **Wise** (बुद्धिमान): Having or showing experience, knowledge, and good judgment.
 
 
• **Example:** It was a wise decision to save money for future emergencies.
